recent_signals.headline: **Qatar LNG collapses again: September 1.6 Mt (most of the war, <¼ pre-war), October tracking just 0.6 Mt 'probably as a result of the rise in attacks on ships' (Kpler via Reuters, 12 Oct); force majeure extended (Bloomberg 28 Sep); trains 4 & 6 (17% of capacity) still 3–5 years.** A tanker was struck ~51nm north of Madinat ash Shamal (7 Oct, casualties) — first attack in Qatari-adjacent waters in a month. Doha relays US–Iran messages ('exchanging messages between the parties', al-Ansari 29 Sep) and backs 'the Pakistani mediation'; condemned the Riyadh airport attack. Al Jazeera's news desk simultaneously led on Houthi–Saudi fighting and UN Yemen casualty figures. Qatar attends today's Trump–GCC meeting. (Al Jazeera; FPJ/Swarajya repeats) — REPORTED (one side).

(ToI liveblog; Al Jazeera; Axios; Argus/CRU) — CONFIRMED (statements) / REPORTED (meeting detail).
